{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for any invalid values in customer_age
invalid_age_mask = (sales_df['customer_age'] < 0) | (sales_df['customer_age'] > 120)
invalid_age_count = invalid_age_mask.sum()

# Display the invalid ages
invalid_ages = sales_df[invalid_age_mask]['customer_age']

invalid_age_count, invalid_ages"}
